#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    echo "usage: $0 CUTOFF_EPOCH" >&2
    exit 2
fi

cutoff=$1
case $cutoff in
    ''|*[!0-9]*)
        echo "$0: cutoff must be a non-negative epoch" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd -P)
cache=$base/cache
active=$base/active.txt

if [ ! -d "$cache" ] || [ ! -r "$active" ]; then
    echo "$0: cache directory or active list is unavailable" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# GNU find defaults to -P, so symlinks are selected as links and never followed.
# GNU stat also uses lstat by default; its timestamp is therefore the link's own.
find -P "$cache" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 \
    \( -type f -o -type l \) -name '*.thumb' \
    -exec sh -c '
        cutoff=$1
        active_file=$2
        shift 2
        for entry do
            name=${entry##*/}
            if grep -F -x -- "$name" "$active_file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                continue
            fi
            mtime=$(stat -c %Y -- "$entry") || exit 1
            if [ "$mtime" -lt "$cutoff" ]; then
                rm -f -- "$entry" || exit 1
            fi
        done
    ' sh "$cutoff" "$active" {} +
